name: llm-eval-gates
description: Evals that block a model or prompt change when it regresses: hard-zero gates for invented values, baselines that only ratchet up, harnesses that reproduce their own pinned numbers before they score, and a judge from a different model family.
author: Jay Sueno

scripts.self-test: node scripts/receipts-eval.mjs && node scripts/surveys-eval.mjs && node scripts/voice-eval.mjs && node scripts/chatbot-eval.mjs
